digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate evaluation fixtures and regression testing
propositions: Only 12 of 50 plan-review criteria have existing eval specs, leaving 38 criteria with no behavioral regression test coverage.
The sidecar corpus contains 6,482 verified plan reviews with per-finding criteria metadata (cohort, decision, decision_margin) sufficient to derive fire/no-fire fixtures for criteria that lack specs.

No-fire fixtures must be admitted only when a criterion appears in a finding's cohort set (proving it was routed) but produced no finding; rows with missing cohort keys are skipped, never emitted as pass cases.
Non-inline-runnable criteria (CONTAINER_CRITERIA, ISF) must be excluded from inline fixture mining and trigger creation of unreliable-criterion tickets instead.
Each criterion lacking a spec and not excluded for non-inline execution must result in either a new spec file under .rebar/evals/ or an open unreliable-criterion ticket by epic completion.
